description.short: Audit Power BI Desktop files: model, DAX, Power Query, RLS and data sources.
description.full: Ask Microsoft 365 Copilot to fully analyze and diagnose a Power BI Desktop file that is open on the host PC. Runs a one-call ranked audit, reads the data model (tables, columns, DAX measures, relationships, row-level security, VertiPaq size), Power Query (M code, refresh errors, query folding) and the report layout (pages, visuals, filters, hidden pages), with deep diagnosis for SQL Server, SharePoint and SharePoint/OneDrive data sources, data-quality probes and dashboard-to-dashboard comparison. It can also edit COPIES of Power BI files, only after you approve each change and type a one-time code shown on your PC; it never refreshes or publishes anything.
